# Monday.com GraphQL API Integration Project

This project provides Python scripts for interacting with Monday.com's GraphQL API.

## Project Overview
- **Language**: Python
- **API**: Monday.com GraphQL API
- **Purpose**: Scripts to interact with Monday boards, items, and columns

## Key Features
- Authentication with Monday.com API token
- Query and manipulate Monday boards
- Create, read, update, delete items
- Manage columns and board structure
- Error handling and rate limiting

## Development Guidelines
- Use environment variables for API tokens
- Implement proper error handling
- Follow Monday.com API best practices
- Include comprehensive logging
- Add type hints and documentation
